decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt was publicly announced as an extension of the brand's popular biodynamic range, sits at the core of the firm's organic and animal-welfare direction, and uses existing yogurt lines, so management is strongly committed to it and would attribute any softness to temporary market conditions.

The mild sliced cheese builds on in-house cheesemaking and was given its own product page only in 2024, so its visible commitment, sunk investment in slicing and packaging, and short time on the market lead management to persist with it.

The sliced butter cheese was launched recently with its own web presence, is close to the core cheese business, and is too new for disappointing listings to be judged as anything but temporary, so management keeps it.
